expand.title: 扩展知识 介词on的搭配
lines: 3 每日习语 tie the knot 结婚；喜结连理
on display/show 展出，陈列 This is the best dress on display / on show . 这是展出的最好的衣服。 There was also a great deal of machinery on display . The most wonderful piece of machinery on show .
on business 因公（与 for pleasure 相对） Last month he went to New York on business and had little time to visit friends. He has gone to Frankfurt on business .
on foot 步行（与 by bus，by car，by air 等相对） I usually go to work by car, but this morning I went on foot . I didn' t catch the bus. I came here on foot . They are going to school on foot .
on duty 值班，值班的 It was Sunday and there was only one doctor on duty . I asked to see the officer on duty .
on the whole 总的看来，总的来说，大体上 On the whole , he is a hard-working student. On the whole , it has been a very successful year.
on fire 起火，着火 Soon the whole building was on fire . Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire .
on purpose 故意地，有意地，特意地（与 by chance 相对） They have come here on purpose to see you. She broke the vase on purpose . I don' t think it was an accident. He did it on purpose .
on the average 平均，通常 On the average , he works more than ten hours a day. On the average , I make six telephone calls a day.
on any account 无论如何，不管怎么说（通常用否定句） Do not interrupt him on any account . You mustn’t on any account sign the contract before you read it.

on second thought(s) 经重新考虑后（thought 用单数或复数均可） I intended to go to the party, but on second thought(s) , I decided to stay at home. I know I had agreed to let you go to the cinema, but on second thoughts , you should stay at home and finish your homework.

exercises.q: While the guard was ___, he heard a shot.
I've changed my mind. ___ I' go by plane instead.
You must not, ___, leave this room.
I'm not always pleased with his work, but ___ it is satisfactory.
